why: Stops holding the module, which is the half of the mechanism that only runs in a real browser. MEASURED: before its guard existed this mutation left the entire vitest suite green, because nothing outside a capture run observes it. The guard that catches it reads the source and says so -- the weakest kind of assertion, used here for the reason the GL seams live in their own harness: the alternative was no guard at all. Re-anchored for issue #781: the find string used to span this line AND the webgl line below it, and the two entry-failure routes now sit between them. Anchored on the holding route alone so a neighbour cannot move it again.
killedBy: capture.mjs: the seams no vitest run can execute (issue #841) holds the module AND commits the navigation, which are one mechanism in two halves
